up: Return the exact activity values and structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4303805. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units for the activity, and the canonical SMILES for the compound structures.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4303805'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
